title: A state-dependent reference changes the meaning of response ratios
statement: For uniform row resistance r, fixed rung g and transverse Laplacian mode lambda, (2+rg lambda)v_k-v_(k-1)-v_(k+1)=0, v0=vL=1, yields physical G=2[(1-v1)/r+g lambda] with end rungs; omit the last term without them. G differs from normalized GLr/2. Conditional on the captured producer normalization proportional to1/r, .205/.396 at120/240ohm imply physical ratio(.396/.205)*(120/240)=.9658536585, about3.4% lower, rather than1.93 higher. The fragmented producer geometry is not reconstructed; ROOT15/16-segment examples are separate models.
